"Having caught Lanolin and Duo in the act, Jewel becomes restless. The needy beetle wants the cat all to herself…and she’s got a weekend’s worth of fooling around to look forward to."

"Timeless: Anthology" is a series of adult stories based in the world of Sonic the Hedgehog told in the form of colorful image sets and comics." - Artist
